BETA Close X Associated British Foods PLC has completed its £250 million share buyback programme, with the final tranche of £125 million concluded on 14 August 2026. The company purchased 68,358 ordinary shares for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited at an average price of GBp 2063.3620, with the highest price paid being GBp 2071.0000 and the lowest GBp 2055.0000. This marks the full execution of the previously announced share repurchase initiative. Disclaimer* Associated British Foods PLC 14 August 2026 14 August 2026 Associated British Foods plc Transaction in own shares Associated British Foods plc (the " Company ") announces that on 14 August 2026 it purchased for cancellation from Barclays Capital Securities Limited (" Barclays ") the following number of its ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence each pursuant to the authority granted by its shareholders as part of its share repurchase programme, details of which were announced on 25 February 2026. Description of shares: Associated British Foods plc Ordinary shares of 5 15/22 pence Date of transaction: 14 August 2026 Number of shares repurchased: 68,358 Average price paid per share: GBp 2063.3620 Highest price paid per share: GBp 2071.0000 Lowest price paid per share: GBp 2055.0000 The Company intends to cancel these Shares. All shares were purchased from Barclays as an on exchange transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. These purchases are the final purchases to be made by Barclays under the second and final £125 million tranche of the £250 million share buyback programme announced on 6 November 2025. That programme has now been completed. The table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Barclays as part of the buyback programme.
